blocks.content: Our code doesn't work if the user enters values other than "rock", "paper" or "scissors".
To handle this problem, we'll ask for user input until the user enters either "rock", "paper" or "scissors".
We can solve this problem by changing the getUserChoice() function.
Now the user will take input until choice is either "rock" or "paper" or "scissors". Next, let's see the updated code.
